summary: A broad set of media-timing, rate-estimation, and safety fixes landed to make audio/video playback and seeking more accurate and resilient. Work includes more correct frame-rate and sample-count measurements, fixes for average-frame-length overflow in ADTS/MP3 demuxing, safer buffer sizing in audio resampling and packetization, and clock-rebasing fixes so an audio stream reused across a seek keeps correct timing. Combined with service-worker response handling and getUserMedia error semantics tweaks, these changes mean fewer glitches, more accurate scrubbing and sync, and more predictable behavior for cached and live media.
